'''Commissioner''' was a high-ranking title used within many [[Planetary Security Forces]]<ref name="UA">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref><ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

Commissioner was the title of the leader of the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. At that time, the position was held by [[Jonah Carter]].<ref name="TOR" /> Commissioner was also the leader of the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] police force.<ref name="LFCG" /> Commissioner was the highest rank of the [[Iltarr City]] [[Iltarr City police|police force]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] the post was held by [[Hildebron]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />

[[Commissioner of the Coruscant Constabulary]] was the title of the commander of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the later years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] control of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After the New Republic captured Coruscant from the Empire in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] believed that former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Fliry Vorru]] wanted the position. However, they quickly decided against it and Vorru also declined to accept the position.<ref name="TKT" />
